intro: I'm a client-facing Implementation Consultant with 3+ years of experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations, customer onboarding, financial workflow optimization, training, and go-live success for Fortune 500 organizations.

At HighRadius, I led multiple end-to-end implementations — increasing automation from 42% to 70% on key workflows and turning around a high-risk Cash Application engagement from red to green in under a month.

At Purdue University, I'm completing an MS in Business Analytics and Information Management while working on a banking practicum focused on operational bottlenecks and data-backed automation recommendations.
